doc.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: Singers who follow him and the Hollywood Bowl tribute
summary: Younger singers like Kevin Mahogany and Paul Broadnax do his repertoire, and he was honored at the Hollywood Bowl.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Do you feel that you are a role model in the way that some people might have been role models for you? I mean I know a singer who just idolizes you — oh I can’t think of it — Kevin Mahagony. He wants to do all the songs you’ve done. He wants to be you.

There’s a marvelous performer, piano player and singer named Paul Broadnax. He’s coming to town just to have a picture made. He has just put out an album and he did almost everything I did in his CD. He and Donn Trenner put it together. And I love it when these kids do things that I do. They honored me at — what was it — at the Hollywood Bowl and all the singers were doing things that I did. And my piano player, Norman Simmons came to me and says, “They’re not going to leave anything for you to do, are they?” It was funny you know. Because they had about 15,000 people out there.
What do you feel is the secret of your success? Would you like to just reflect on that for a minute? Is there any secret? I know you said exposure was very important.
